title: Docker Microservice Stack

dimensions.label: Service Separation
dimensions.description: Clear separation of concerns across nginx, api, and db tiers.

bands.label: Monolithic
bands.criteria: Only one or two services defined. Responsibilities collapsed into a single container.

bands.label: Partial
bands.criteria: Two services present but missing the reverse proxy tier or lacking clear role separation.

bands.label: Three-Tier
bands.criteria: All three tiers defined (nginx, api, db) with clear responsibilities. nginx handles ingress, api handles logic, db handles persistence.

dimensions.label: Network Isolation
dimensions.description: Services communicate via a named network; no unnecessary port exposure.

bands.label: No Network
bands.criteria: No named network declared. Services rely on default bridge networking.

bands.label: Named Network
bands.criteria: Named network declared but not all services are attached, or db port is exposed unnecessarily to the host.

bands.label: Fully Isolated
bands.criteria: Named network declared and all services attached. Only nginx exposes a host port. DB is internal-only.

dimensions.label: Resilience
dimensions.description: Healthchecks and restart policies present and correctly wired.

bands.label: None
bands.criteria: No healthchecks or restart policies. Stack is fragile on startup race conditions.

bands.label: Partial
bands.criteria: Healthchecks or restart policies present on some services but not wired end-to-end (e.g. depends_on still uses list form).

bands.label: Full Chain
bands.criteria: All services have restart policies. db has healthcheck. depends_on chain uses condition: service_healthy throughout.

dimensions.label: Data Persistence
dimensions.description: Named volume used for database storage; not anonymous or bind-mounted.

bands.label: No Persistence
bands.criteria: No volume defined for db. Data is lost when the container restarts.

bands.label: Anonymous Volume
bands.criteria: Volume defined but as an anonymous volume or bind mount — hard to manage and back up.

bands.label: Named Volume
bands.criteria: Named volume declared in the top-level volumes key and mounted at the correct Postgres data path.

grade_bands.label: B
grade_bands.description: Functional but missing resilience or isolation.

llm_judge_instructions: Evaluate the Docker Compose YAML submitted. Look for correct three-tier separation (nginx/api/db), named network with proper isolation, named volume for persistence, and full healthcheck+restart chain. Reward explicit condition: service_healthy in depends_on. Penalise exposed db ports, anonymous volumes, and absent restart policies.
